强化期第 2 天。今天的主题是学习和在国外生活：选课、作业、导师、保险、住处、参加社区活动。这些是听力 Part 1 到 Part 3 的高频场景，以后去澳洲读书、工作、办事也天天用得上。卡片里「≈」后面是同义替换，背的时候连同替换说法一起读出来。

例句

  • The insurance offers comprehensive cover. = It's an all-inclusive package.（这份保险提供全面保障。）
  • Maths is compulsory, but art is optional. = Maths is a core subject, but you can choose art.（数学是必修，美术是选修。）
  • It's hard to maintain your motivation when you study alone. = It's hard to keep up your drive.（一个人学习时很难一直保持动力。）
  • I've decided to enrol on a cooking course. = I'm going to sign up for a cooking course.（我决定报一个烹饪班。）
  • Libraries aren't confined to lending books. = They're not limited to lending books.（图书馆不只是借书。）
  • I haven't decided yet. = I haven't made up my mind yet. / I'll think about it.（我还没决定。）

过关标准：遮住中文看英文，能说出 22 个以上的意思，而且每个词至少能说出一个同义替换。再挑 5 个造句，把同一句话用两种说法各说一遍。

今天继续用雅思官方样题（ielts.org 官方 Sample tasks），一共 4 段短录音，覆盖 Part 1、2、3 和三种新题型：单选、简答、句子填空、配对。录音 1 是昨天那位寄箱子的顾客选保险（约 1 分钟）；录音 2 是英国文化协会的讲座，讲在英国怎么交朋友（约 1.5 分钟）；录音 3 是两个朋友聊开放大学（约 1.5 分钟）；录音 4 是学生和导师商量选课（约 3 分钟）。音频和题目都放在页面里了。

  1. 先把上面的听前生词过一遍，听不太懂可以先读懂原文再听。
  2. 按考试方式做一遍：每段先花 20 秒看题，划出关键词，然后只听一遍，边听边做，不暂停。做完点「对答案」。
  3. 第二遍精听：红色的题先别看答案，再听一遍那段，实在听不出来再点开原文找。
  4. 第三遍对原文：对照下面「同义替换」那几组，在原文里看粗体的地方。今天重点练「态度题」：录音 4 里 Jack 从来没直接说 A、B、C，你要从 I'll sign up for that / I'll think about that one / I'll forget about that one 这种说法判断他的态度。
  5. 最后挑 Rachel 那段（"Well it took me a while to get used to it..."）跟读一遍，模仿语气和重音。

今天录音里的同义替换和陷阱（题目 → 录音）

  • Premium → the highest comprehensive cover → I'll go for the highest（录音先说了 Economy，那是干扰项）
  • delivered to port → would you want to pick it up at the nearest port? → The port'd be fine（home 和 depot 都提到了，但都被否定）
  • factors make social contact difficult → not just because of the language, but because customs may be different
  • information can be found → the best places to get information ... town hall or the public library
  • demanded a great deal of motivation → I needed to maintain a high level of motivation
  • structured in modules → the degree is made up of modules
  • He'll definitely do it (A) → I'll sign up for that
  • He may or may not do it (B) → I'll think about that one / I might wait until then to decide
  • He won't do it (C) → I'd rather do something completely new / I'll forget about that one

录音 1：货运保险和取货方式（Part 1，Q9–10）

Agent：OK right. Now obviously insurance is an important thing to consider and our companies are able to offer very good rates费率，价格 in a number of different all-inclusive全包的，包含一切的 packages.

Agent：好的。保险显然是一件需要考虑的重要事情，我们合作的公司可以提供好几种全包套餐，价格都很优惠。

Customer：Sorry, could you explain a bit more?

Customer：不好意思，能再解释一下吗？

Agent：Yes, sorry, um. There's really three rates费率，价格 according to quality of insurance cover – there's the highest comprehensive全面的 cover which is Premium高级的，优质的 rate, then there's Standard rate and then there's Economy rate. That one will only cover the cost of the contents second hand.

Agent：好的，抱歉，嗯。按保障程度其实分三档：最高的是全面保障，叫 Premium（高级）档；然后是 Standard（标准）档；再就是 Economy（经济）档。经济档只按二手价赔里面的东西。

Customer：Oh I've been stung吃过亏，被坑过 before with Economy insurance so I'll go for选择 the highest.

Customer：哦，我以前买经济档保险吃过亏，所以我选最高的。

Agent：Mh'hm and can I just check would you want home delivery or to a local depot仓库，货站 or would you want to pick it up at the nearest port?

Agent：嗯嗯。我再确认一下：您是要送货上门，还是送到当地的仓库，还是您自己去最近的港口取？

Customer：The port'd be fine – I've got transport that end（运输的）那一头.

Customer：港口就行，我在那边有车可以运。

Agent：Fine and will you be paying by credit card?

Agent：好的。您用信用卡付款吗？

Customer：Can I pay by cheque支票?

Customer：我可以用支票付吗？

录音 2：英国文化协会讲座，在英国怎么交朋友（Part 2，Q11–16）

John Parker：Good evening, and welcome to the British Council. My name is John Parker and I've been asked to talk to you briefly about certain aspects方面 of life in the UK before you actually go there. So I'm going to talk first about the best ways of making social contacts社会交往，人脉 there. Now you might be wondering why it should be necessary. After all, we meet people all the time. But when you're living in a foreign country it can be more difficult, not just because of the language, but because customs风俗习惯 may be different.

John Parker：晚上好，欢迎来到英国文化协会。我叫 John Parker，今天请我在大家出发之前，简单讲讲英国生活的几个方面。我先讲讲在那里结交朋友的最好方法。你们可能会想，这有什么必要？毕竟我们每天都在跟人打交道。但住在外国的时候，交朋友可能会更难，不只是因为语言，还因为风俗习惯可能不一样。

John Parker：If you're going to work in the UK you will probably be living in private accommodation住处, so it won't be quite so easy to meet people. But there are still things that you can do to help yourself. First of all, you can get involved in参与 activities in your local community, join a group of some kind. For example, you'll probably find that there are theatre groups who might be looking for actors, set designers舞台布景设计师 and so on, or if you play an instrument乐器 you could join music groups in your area. Or if you like the idea of finding out about local history there'll be a group for that too.

John Parker：如果你们是去英国工作，多半会住私人租的房子，所以认识人就没那么容易了。不过还是有办法自己想办法的。首先，可以参加本地社区的活动，加入某种小组。比如，你们大概会发现有戏剧社在找演员、布景设计之类的人；如果你会乐器，可以加入当地的音乐小组；要是你有兴趣了解当地历史，也会有这方面的小组。

John Parker：These are just examples. And the best places to get information about things like this are either the town hall市政厅 or the public library. Libraries in the UK perform quite a broad range of functions nowadays – they're not just confined局限 to lending books, although that's their main role of course.

John Parker：这些只是举几个例子。要了解这类活动的信息，最好的地方要么是市政厅，要么是公共图书馆。现在英国的图书馆功能挺多的，不只局限于借书，当然借书还是它们的主要作用。

常见失分点：Q9 别因为先听到 Economy 就选 A；Q21 Jack 说 that was interesting，但后面一个 but 转折，他其实不选；Q25 他一开始说 quite interested，最后 I'll forget about that one，以最后的决定为准。听到 but、actually、in fact 后面往往才是答案。

过关标准：四段一共 17 题，第一遍对 13 题以上就算达标；第二遍要弄清每道错题错在哪：没听到、被干扰项带跑、同义替换没反应过来，还是拼写错了。

小练习（同义替换）

  1. I'd like to ______ up for the evening class.（= enrol）
  2. It's hard to keep ______ your motivation.（= maintain）
  3. Swimming lessons are ______ for all students.（= required）
  4. The library isn't ______ to lending books.（= limited）
  5. I haven't made up my ______ yet.（= decided）
  6. Do you plan to ______ in marketing?（= focus on）
点开看答案

1. sign　2. up　3. compulsory　4. confined　5. mind　6. specialize / specialise

今天的小思考（为口语 Part 1 和 Part 3 做准备）：Have you ever studied online? 用英语说两三句：Yes, I've done ... / The hardest part was staying motivated because ...。再想想：Is it easier to make friends when you live in a foreign country or in your home country? Why?
